CHATQUEST Turn “just watching” into an adventure.

Bring your chat along.

For a live stream
  1. Run the downloaded project with npm start.
  2. Connect Twitch here in one control-room tab.
  3. Add http://localhost:3000/overlay to OBS at 1920 × 1080.

The hosted edition is a playground. Its overlay shares state only with tabs in the same browser.

Connect a Twitch channel using your own account’s chat token. Credentials stay in this tab’s memory.

Local server mode syncs OBS through /overlay. Hosted demo syncs tabs in the same browser only.

From viewers to heroes.

  1. Join a guild with !join sun or !join moon.
  2. Streamer starts each chapter.
  3. Solve the gate riddle using !solve echo.
  4. Vote for bridge or forest. One vote per hero; voting ends when time expires.
  5. The bridge grants !charge once per hero for a stronger next attack. The forest grants !grow once per hero for five extra seconds.
  6. Defeat the wyrm with !attack. Each hero can strike every two seconds. Boss health scales to the party when the chapter opens.

OBS: run the local server and add http://localhost:3000/overlay as a 1920 × 1080 Browser Source.
